model_family: Positive finite-sample exponential-rank marginal reconstruction with stable-person and optional shared visit Gaussian factors

evidence_use.operator: arithmetic means and sample SDs on complete endpoint pairs
evidence_use.population: 12 adult men aged 35-55 with abdominal overweight/obesity; fasting measurements before/after 3 days at approximately 50% usual energy intake; no control arm.
evidence_use.measurement: Units specified per endpoint; serum leptin is raw ng/mL, not a log transformation
evidence_use.reason: Use the eight supplied raw-scale means and sample SDs as exact rounded A0 reconstruction inputs. They identify marginal first and second moments and four mean differences, but do not identify pairing, paired uncertainty, cross-endpoint changes or marginal shape. Their target-derived provenance makes marginal agreement a construction check, not independent validation. Leptin remains raw ng/mL.

evidence_use.population: 12 adult men aged 35-55 with abdominal overweight/obesity; fasting measurements before/after 3 days at approximately 50% usual energy intake; no control arm.
evidence_use.reason: Use the two fasting visits, one row per synthetic person, and exact endpoint pair counts. Scale each count by round(endpoint_n * n / source_n) and share each endpoint mask across visits. All four endpoints have 12 complete pairs here. Eligibility and the three-day protocol constrain interpretation; unrecorded age, sex and intake values are not fabricated. No control arm identifies a causal effect.

components.name: synthetic_keys_complete_pairs_and_reproducibility
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Same population and visit protocol; new context/seed-prefixed synthetic keys. Pair counts scale with requested n. If counts ever differ, missing pairs are independently selected across endpoints, a fallback assumption unused by this complete packet.
components.implementation: Local numpy.random.default_rng(seed), no evidence mutation or generator I/O; fixed schema order; one mask per endpoint for both visits.

components.name: positive_raw_marginal_reconstruction
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Condition each finite cohort on the supplied rounded raw-scale arithmetic mean and sample SD.
components.implementation: Calibrate a monotone exponential transform of latent scores to the sample coefficient of variation by brentq and rescale to the arithmetic mean. No authored patient rows, clipping or target-analysis fitting.
components.limitations: Exponential-rank finite cohorts are a marginal-shape assumption, not independent lognormal sampling. Conditioning suppresses marginal sampling variation and does not propagate rounding uncertainty. The transform preserves ranks, not Pearson correlations. n=0 yields the empty schema; one observed pair uses only the mean since sample SD is undefined; infeasible positive moments raise an error.

components.name: latent_joint_dependence
components.source_to_target_assumptions: A shared stable-person factor has variance a=0.20. Endpoint-specific stable variation has variance rho_e-a. Visit variation has variance 1-rho_e; a fraction q is shared across endpoints at a visit, with the two shared visit factors independent.
components.implementation: Z_et = sqrt(a)*C + sqrt(rho_e-a)*S_e + sqrt(1-rho_e)*(sqrt(q)*U_t + sqrt(1-q)*E_et). All primitive factors are independent standard normal. q=0 omits U_t. This explicit factor construction is positive semidefinite.
components.parameter_meaning: Before marginal reconstruction, within-endpoint pre/post correlation is rho_e; cross-endpoint cross-visit covariance is a; same-visit cross-endpoint covariance is a+q*sqrt((1-rho_e)*(1-rho_f)). These are assumed latent coefficients, never empirical estimates.
components.limitations: No numerical dependence parameter is supplied. Positive same-visit loading is an examined assumption, not evidence of any observed change-correlation direction. Finite cohort reconstruction can alter Pearson dependence.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Retain the source-compatible parent as the continuity scenario. The repeated-measure design permits stable person differences, but the prior source checks do not validate this pairing.

Independent validation of mean changes from target-derived reconstruction inputs.
Empirical claims about paired covariance, change SDs, paired interval coverage or six change correlations.

Treating any latent coefficient or absence of common innovation in two scenarios as an estimated fact.
